name: coulomb-deflection
title: Coulomb Deflection
physics: A +par stream bends around a +q charged wall (same-sign cap=4 declines) and dives through a -q wall (opposite-sign cap=8 binds). The charge-sign binding law made spatial.

seed.comment: one scene at a time — repel: +q wall + +par stream piles up at it; attract: -q wall + +par stream passes through. |q|=40 gives the cap=4 vs cap=8 contrast (|q|=104 clamps both to 4).

timeline.expect: repel: spray piles up at the wall, downstream thins; attract: stream passes through
steady-state barrier-vs-doorway — the field is the wall

verified: ev45=331 same-sign declines vs 35 baseline on +104 target (harness-proven)
